rationale: Build on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline by reallocating a small amount of fp16 keep budget directly into the recurrent value path at export time. The best local family is quantization-sensitive in the tail, and prior value-path float reallocation was one of the few real step-changes; this makes that bias explicit and compact by preserving `attn.c_v.weight` for the last two blocks instead of only the final block, while leaving training, traversal, and wallclock behavior unchanged.
title: Tail Value FP16 Expansion
